title: BPW-2026-0520
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0520
BOE
CD 14
REVISED WORK ORDER NUMBER – TASK ORDER SOLICITATION (TOS) NO. ED21-055 – HOLLENBECK PARK LAKE REHABILITATION AND SEWER REPLACEMENT PROJECT
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to issue the task to Environmental Science Associates from the Pre-Qualified On-Call Environmental Documentation Consultant Services List to provide an Environmental Impact Report for the Hollenbeck Park Lake Rehabilitation and Sewer Replacement Project, as stated in TOS No. ED21-055, with a budget authority of $1,376,000, including contingency.
(W.O.: S343HPLR, SZC14544, C-139063)
(REF: BPW-2026-0476)
(This report revises the Board Report adopted on 09-14-2026 to correct the Work Order No. from S333HPLR to Work Order No. S343HPLR. All other aspects of the report remain unchanged.)
summary: Authorization for City Engineer to issue task order for Environmental Impact Report for Hollenbeck Park Lake Rehabilitation and Sewer Replacement Project with budget authority of $1,376,000.

flag.reason: Environmental review for rehabilitating the lake at Hollenbeck Park, a public park, together with a sewer replacement.

outcome.text: REPORT ADOPTED, SUBJECT TO CONDITIONS, FORTHWITH
